procedure.name: Q4
procedure.statement: SELECT o.o_ol_cnt, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM oorder o LEFT JOIN order_line ol ON o.o_id = ol.ol_o_id AND o.o_w_id = ol.ol_w_id AND o.o_d_id = ol.ol_d_id AND ol.ol_delivery_d >= o.o_entry_d WHERE ol.ol_o_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_ol_cnt ORDER BY o.o_ol_cnt

procedure.name: Q5
procedure.statement: SELECT n_name, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM customer, oorder, order_line, stock, supplier, nation, region WHERE c_id = o_c_id AND c_w_id = o_w_id AND c_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id AND ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_i_id = s_i_id AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND c_state_key = su_nationkey AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'Europe' AND o_entry_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

procedure.name: Q7
procedure.statement: SELECT su_nationkey AS supp_nation, SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_entry_d) AS l_year, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM supplier, stock, order_line, oorder, customer, nation n1, nation n2 WHERE ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_i_id = s_i_id AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id AND c_id = o_c_id AND c_w_id = o_w_id AND c_d_id = o_d_id AND su_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND c_state_key = n2.n_nationkey AND ((n1.n_name = 'Germany' AND n2.n_name = 'Cambodia') OR (n1.n_name = 'Cambodia' AND n2.n_name = 'Germany')) GROUP BY su_nationkey, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY su_nationkey, cust_nation, l_year

procedure.name: Q8
procedure.statement: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_entry_d) AS l_year, sum(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'Germany' THEN ol_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(ol_amount) AS mkt_share FROM item, supplier, stock, order_line, oorder, customer, nation n1, nation n2, region WHERE i_id = s_i_id AND ol_i_id = s_i_id AND ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id AND c_id = o_c_id AND c_w_id = o_w_id AND c_d_id = o_d_id AND n1.n_nationkey = c_state_key AND n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND ol_i_id < 1000 AND r_name = 'Europe' AND su_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND i_data LIKE '%b' AND i_id = ol_i_id GROUP BY l_year ORDER BY l_year

procedure.name: Q10
procedure.statement: SELECT c_id, c_last, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue, c_city, c_phone, n_name FROM customer, oorder, order_line, nation WHERE c_id = o_c_id AND c_w_id = o_w_id AND c_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_w_id = o_w_id AND ol_d_id = o_d_id AND ol_o_id = o_id AND o_entry_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' AND o_entry_d <= ol_delivery_d AND n_nationkey = c_state_key GROUP BY c_id, c_last, c_city, c_phone, n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

procedure.name: Q15
procedure.statement: UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

SELECT su_suppkey, su_name, su_address, su_phone, total_revenue FROM supplier, (SELECT mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) AS supplier_no, sum(ol_amount) AS total_revenue FROM order_line, stock WHERE ol_i_id = s_i_id AND ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_delivery_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY supplier_no) revenue0 WHERE su_suppkey = supplier_no AND total_revenue = (SELECT max(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) AS supplier_no, sum(ol_amount) AS total_revenue FROM order_line, stock WHERE ol_i_id = s_i_id AND ol_supply_w_id = s_w_id AND ol_delivery_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY supplier_no) revenue0_inner) ORDER BY su_suppkey
UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

procedure.name: Q21
procedure.statement: SELECT su_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait FROM supplier JOIN nation ON su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'Germany' JOIN stock ON mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey JOIN order_line l1 ON l1.ol_w_id = s_w_id AND l1.ol_i_id = s_i_id JOIN oorder ON l1.ol_o_id = o_id AND l1.ol_w_id = o_w_id AND l1.ol_d_id = o_d_id AND l1.ol_delivery_d > o_entry_d LEFT JOIN order_line l2 ON l2.ol_o_id = l1.ol_o_id AND l2.ol_w_id = l1.ol_w_id AND l2.ol_d_id = l1.ol_d_id AND l2.ol_delivery_d > l1.ol_delivery_d WHERE l2.ol_o_id IS NULL GROUP BY su_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, su_name

procedure.name: Q22
procedure.statement: WITH avg_balance AS ( SELECT AVG(c_balance) AS threshold FROM customer WHERE c_balance > 0.00 AND SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') ) SELECT SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) AS country, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_balance) AS totacctbal FROM customer CROSS JOIN avg_balance LEFT JOIN oorder ON o_c_id = c_id AND o_w_id = c_w_id AND o_d_id = c_d_id WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') AND c_balance > avg_balance.threshold AND o_c_id IS NULL GROUP BY SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) ORDER BY SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1)
